key_terms.السَّابِقُونَ: The foremost, those who excel in faith and deeds

ai.seo_question: Who are the Al-Sabiqun (the foremost) in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the concept of *Sabiqun* (the Pioneers), with some scholars identifying the Prophet Muhammad, Imam Ali, and the Imams as the ultimate exemplars of this rank due to their early and unwavering faith. The repetition of 'Al-Sabiqun' emphasizes the urgency and superiority of those who race ahead in righteous deeds, distinguishing them from the 'Ashab al-Yamin' (Companions of the Right Hand). This hierarchy underscores the Shia belief in the spiritual preeminence of the Ahl al-Bayt as the foremost believers.
